The setting is inherited from v20 unchanged, so this round measures the window and does not re-measure the gate. Trigger policy stays symmetric_budget so the wrapper is not removed from the plugin arm.

registry_fork.only_change: the contract prompt of every task gains the length-discipline text below; the tasks, views, ranges, blob ids, view hashes, literals, frozen regexes, registered requests, protocol steps, cause and fix tokens, the 160-character bound and the renderer are unchanged
length_discipline_texts: Length discipline: this is a hard rejection criterion, not a preference. The host accepts the answer only when the whole rendered line "RESULT issue=<issue> cause=<cause> fix=<fix>" is at most 160 characters, and when it is longer the host rejects the ENTIRE answer, so the answer is lost and the sample scores zero. Work to a target well below the bound: write cause and fix so that the two fields together come to about 120 characters or less, leaving room under the 160-character limit. Do not buy that room by dropping anything: every required string and both required technical names must still appear verbatim inside cause or fix, and an abbreviation, a shorter spelling or a summary of one of them does not count as the required string.

Budget for this task: the issue value "{issue}" plus the fixed prefix "RESULT issue=" and the fixed markers " cause=" and " fix=" already take {fixed} characters of the 160, so everything you write in the cause and fix fields together must stay within {headroom} characters to be accepted.

retry.where: the v24 live contract's RETRY_INSTRUCTION and its over_160_chars diagnostic

evidence.retry_instruction: Rewrite only your preceding JSON answer. Keep the same issue, the same cause, the same fix and the same fact strings. Reply with the same JSON object shape (issue, cause, fix, facts) and nothing else: no explanation, no commentary, no markdown, no text before or after the object. Do not call tools. If the host rejected the answer, its exact reason follows and your rewrite must fix it. Work to a compact target: write cause and fix so that the two fields together come to about 120 characters or less.
evidence.v17_retry_instruction: Rewrite only your preceding JSON answer. Keep the same issue, the same cause, the same fix and the same fact strings. Reply with the same JSON object shape (issue, cause, fix, facts) and nothing else. Do not call tools. If the host rejected the answer, its exact reason follows and your rewrite must fix it.
evidence.over_160_diagnostic: the host rejected your previous JSON: over_160_chars. the rendered line 'RESULT issue=... cause=... fix=...' exceeded 160 characters. Shorten "cause" and "fix" while keeping every fact string and every required technical name. Reply with the JSON object only and nothing else, with no explanation around it. The length of the cause and fix fields together is what pushes the rendered line past the 160-character limit, so as a target write the two fields to come to about 120 characters or less in total; that leaves the rendered line comfortably inside the bound. The limit is enforced by the host on the whole rendered line, so an answer over it is rejected entirely. The rendered line must stay within 160 characters. These strings must still appear verbatim in it: '__hash__', '__eq__', 'creation_counter'. The cause field must still contain '__hash__'. The fix field must still contain 'creation_counter'. Keep the answer as short as the required strings allow: drop explanations, restatements and repeated names, and never state the same fact twice. Remove wording, not requirements: a shorter line that loses a required string is rejected as well.

budget_arithmetic.derivation: READ_CALLS=3 => MAX_TURNS = 3+2 = 5 => worst case 6 per sample => 45x6 + 15x2 = 300 => 1.3x => 390

acceptance_line.line: per task, the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's (the four conditions judged on the rendered line) AND the paired complete provider-token saving is positive for a majority of pairs AND the batch mean is positive. The verdict is decided on every pair of the frozen matrix; the symmetric matched-prefix reading, the byte reading, the strict-track and semantic-accuracy endpoints per arm and the per-arm call distribution are reported beside it and never substitute for it. Failures, cap hits, retries and summary requests are all charged to their arm.
acceptance_line.decided_on: every pair of the frozen matrix
acceptance_line.strict_track: the four conditions judged on the rendered line: required facts present, frozen regex full match, single line with the contract prefix, at most 160 characters
acceptance_line.paired_statistic: paired complete provider-token totals per (task, repeat) pair, with retries and summary tokens charged to the arm they belong to
acceptance_line.bounds_are_not_relaxed: at most 160 characters remains an acceptance condition

primary_criterion.name: as-paired complete provider tokens
primary_criterion.definition: for every (task, repeat) pair: (baseline total tokens - plugin total tokens) / baseline total tokens, where a sample's total is its complete provider input tokens plus its complete provider output tokens, with retries and summary requests charged to the arm they belong to
primary_criterion.verdict: per task: the plugin arm's strict track is at least the baseline's; across the batch: a majority of pairs positive and the mean positive
primary_criterion.never_merged_with: the v16 sealed confirmation batch's 12.54 percent is reported beside this batch's number and the two are never merged and never pooled, because the host configuration and the mechanism differ

co_reported.name: symmetric matched prefix, provider tokens
co_reported.definition: for each pair, take the first k model calls of EACH arm, where k = min(baseline calls, plugin calls), and compare the summed complete provider input tokens of those two prefixes; the truncation must be symmetric, so an arm's own retry cannot hide inside its own sum

co_reported.name: matched prefix, context bytes
co_reported.definition: the same symmetric prefix over the per-boundary context bytes the recorder wrote for each model input

co_reported.name: strict track and semantic accuracy per arm
co_reported.definition: rate per arm, per task and pooled

co_reported.name: mechanism counters and guard fallbacks
co_reported.definition: v21_* per task and per sample

co_reported.name: determinism of the mechanism's byte saving per repeat
co_reported.definition: the v21 counters of the three repeats of each task side by side

co_reported.name: requests, cap and cache
co_reported.definition: api_request_attempts against the cap, and the provider cache split

not_evidence_yet: both citation flags stay false until the independent audit passes; the three tasks of this batch took no part in building the host configuration, but the configuration itself - and the window K - was calibrated on other tasks, so this batch confirms the configuration and the mechanism on an untouched task set rather than establishing a general result
tool_output_disclosure: the plugin arm's read output may be elided: lines that carry no registered literal are removed and every maximal omitted run is replaced by exactly one explicit interval note of the form [elided n lines first-last], so the omission is declared and the omitted range is recoverable by re-issuing the read. Every registered literal keeps at least as many verbatim occurrences as it had before the elision; the reader tool's own description is identical in all three arms, because the frozen registry builds it once per task and v21 does not rewrite it for any arm, so 'returns those numbered lines verbatim' holds for every line that is kept. No silent omission occurs: nothing is removed without an interval note.

re_read_visibility.rule: per arm: tool_calls and model_calls are reported for every sample, so a re-read induced by an elision appears as extra tool calls and is billed

stop_conditions: batch mean at or below zero -> stop and report
any task whose plugin strict track or semantic accuracy is below its baseline -> stop and report, do not add samples and do not change the reading
